notes.subject: Kenaan
notes.rationale: כנען read as 'merchant' (KJV 'trafficker') vs literal 'Canaan/Canaanite'; pun on the trader people, kept as name

notes.subject: minan fila
notes.rationale: מאזני is dual — the two pans of the balance kept as 'fila' (two)

notes.subject: כנען / מרמה
notes.rationale: charge of Canaanite-style deceitful commerce; wordplay on the nation's name lost in any single rendering

translation: Kenaan — minan fila minnu bɛ fɛn-dɔgɔya, olu bɛ a bolo kɔnɔ; a kanuya ka mɔgɔw jonya.
